text: 58-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of burning pain in his neck and arms, accompanying paresthesias in his hands. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy with bilateral Radiculopathy.

Based on your 58 years of age, diabetes, and the specific combination of burning neck pain, hand paresthesias, and progressive bilateral hand weakness over three months, the clinical picture strongly suggests cervical spinal cord compression, likely due to degenerative changes or disc herniation. This is a serious condition that requires immediate evaluation to prevent permanent neurological damage. I am requesting urgent imaging to confirm the level and severity of the compression.
